page.notes: The Hebrew words and root letters are small and blurred in the scan; I could not read them letter by letter, so each is marked illegible rather than guessed. The Latin grammatical abbreviations were read directly. "Jer. 59. 13" is doubtful ("Jef." in print, read as Jer.). "Pual" is read from "Paul" and may be a printing error. The running heads and catchword are Hebrew letters and are unreadable at this resolution.
